title: UH-1B / UH-1C / UH-1D Iroquois (Huey)

sources.title: JoyPro cockpit catalog (panels, items and grip functions of the variant)

intro: The UH-1B and UH-1C are the early Hueys of the 1960s with a short cabin, often armed as gunships with machine guns and rockets; the UH-1D is the long-cabin version that came just before the UH-1H. All of them have one turbine engine, one big two-bladed rotor and two pilots side by side with dual controls. The UH-1D has practically the same cockpit as the UH-1H, so this guide uses the DCS UH-1H cockpit. The B and C had older, weaker engines and other gun and rocket systems, so their armament panels differed in detail from the M21 panel described here. The rescue hoist switch of the H is left out.
